purpose: Machine-readable handoff for NICME multiclass EyePACS DR and PMI Pills extension.

mc2.reason: Known HF ConvNeXt and PEFT/timm LoRA failure modes caused D-state processes; reboot/reset required before further GPU work.

mc3.reason: Wait for MC2 completion and selection.

known_failures.name: HF ConvNeXt PyTorch/CUDA instability
symptoms: focused repro froze while holding CUDA memory
known_failures.current_policy: Quarantine HF ConvNeXt from default MC2/MC3/MC4 plans.

known_failures.name: PEFT/timm LoRA wrapper failure
symptoms: failed in model.train() with TypeError: cannot unpack non-iterable Linear object
left a D-state Python process after stop
known_failures.current_policy: Do not abandon LoRA. Fix wrapper/checkpoint interaction, then run multi-epoch LoRA stability gate before MC2.

current_code_caveat.description: During emergency debugging, run_multiclass_experiments.py defaults may have been changed to non-PEFT timm models and abort-on-failure hardening. This must be revisited because user confirmed LoRA is a key paper claim.
current_code_caveat.required_resolution: Restore LoRA as primary after fixing PEFT/timm integration, or obtain explicit user approval for any claim change.

recommended_next_steps: Reboot/reset GPU if any D-state Python training process remains.
Inspect and fix nicme/modeling.py PEFT/timm LoRA application.
Prefer applying PEFT to the underlying timm model before wrapping, avoid fragile dotted modules_to_save on the outer wrapper, and keep head trainable manually.
Add CPU/unit tests for repeated train/eval cycles on timm LoRA models.
Run a 4-5 epoch LoRA stability gate with checkpoints before MC2.
Relaunch MC2 with timm_dinov3_vit_lora and timm_dinov3_convnext_lora only after the stability gate passes.
Run MC2 selection and then MC3.

post_reboot_preflight: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${d##*/}; state=$(awk '/^State:/ {print $2}' "$d/status" 2>/dev/null) || continue; if [ "$state" = D ]; then name=$(awk '/^Name:/ {print $2}' "$d/status" 2>/dev/null); echo "$p $name D"; fi; done
micromamba run -n ml ruff check scripts/run_multiclass_experiments.py scripts/train.py
recommended_commands.mc2_lora_fixed: micromamba run -n ml python scripts/run_multiclass_experiments.py --stop mc2 --datasets eyepacs_dr,pmi_pills --variants balanced --models timm_dinov3_vit_lora,timm_dinov3_convnext_lora --output-dir results/multiclass_mc2_lora_fixed_20260501 --execute --per-run-timeout-minutes 60
